anyOf.description: A link to the evidence. Use kind "url" for any web link (documents, Notion, Slack, Teams, Drive, calendar), "email" for an email thread, "workspace" for a local file, or linear/github/asana for a ticket.

kind.description: Which kind of reference (required): workspace (needs path), url (needs url), email (needs threadId), linear (needs issueId), github (needs owner + repo + issueNumber), asana (needs taskId).

path.description: Text. Used by kind workspace (required); ignored for other kinds.

url.description: Text. Used by kind url (required); ignored for other kinds.

threadId.description: Text. Used by kind email (required); ignored for other kinds.

messageId.description: Text. Used by kind email; ignored for other kinds.

provider.description: One of: gmail, outlook. Used by kind email; ignored for other kinds.

issueId.description: Text. Used by kind linear (required); ignored for other kinds.

owner.description: Text. Used by kind github (required); ignored for other kinds.

repo.description: Text. Used by kind github (required); ignored for other kinds.

issueNumber.description: Number. Used by kind github (required); ignored for other kinds.

taskId.description: Text. Used by kind asana (required); ignored for other kinds.

label.description: Text. Used by kind workspace, url, email, linear, github, asana; ignored for other kinds.
